title: Agent assurance ambiguity pilot: harness, tasks and raw results
description: Open harness, task pool, labeled implementation pool and raw validator verdicts for a pilot study of how often accept/reject/hold decisions on agent-written code are correct as validator independence varies, with specification ambiguity as a planted common cause.
notes: Self-funded; no external funding. v1.1.0 adds the gpt-5.1 reviewer verdicts and replaces mock outputs with real runs (see CHANGELOG.md).
